Product Details: The Makita 513494-5 Armature is a genuine replacement spare part engineered for the Makita M2401B 355 mm (14 inch) Portable Cut Off Saw. Designed for 220–240V operation, this armature is a key internal component of the 2,000W motor system. If your cut off saw has reduced power, overheating issues or motor failure due to a worn or damaged armature, this replacement part helps restore original performance and efficiency. Manufactured to Makita’s precise engineering standards, it ensures proper fitment and reliable operation when installed correctly. This armature is typically used alongside carbon brushes during motor servicing to ensure optimal performance. Important: This listing includes the armature assembly only. Brushes and other motor components are not included.
